The Gardener

A downloadable game for Windows and macOS

Buy Now$1.00 USD or more
Your friend died in the spring and was buried in the soft grass. Drinking next to his grave, you meet a monster and must answer his call.

Experience a short visual novel about trans grief and the monster you must reckon with.

Content Warnings:  Death, Transphobia, Vague Horror Elements, Monster

by Petallix Games

Code: Aeris [Website][Twitter]
Story: E. L. Sonder [Twitter]
Art: DacuriBlue [Website][Twitter]

queenychu3 years ago(+1)

it was so rude for life to get in the way of me playing this!! a sad tale that unfortunately will strike a cord with many of us, while to others it may be a greatest fear.

being buried a stranger, or someone you love being buried as one, is a terrible horror that trans people face-- and the raw, ugly, unrelenting feelings that come with that fear is expressed beautifully here.


the entire team here should feel proud, all the mediums working together to make a very impactful experience.

sootyble3 years ago(+1)

very cohesive, beautiful design and a story that kept my attention until the very end. a neat use of horror as an outlet to process grief and anger over an injustice -- especially when so often that anger has nowhere to go. my only issue is that there wasn't a back button when i accidentally clicked too fast.


final note, I have trouble with reading and maintaining focus, but this novel was just the right length for someone who gets distracted easily to finish in one sitting.

lilblkrose3 years ago(+1)

Very cool atmosphere and writing that you can smell it. Despite the monster frightening (or hot?) appearance, it was that one line from MC talking about their friend that inflicted fear and frustration in me.

My suggestion and criticism so far; Would of liked a Go-Back or progress button instead of entire screen since I misclick twice and had to restart. There were two scenes that felt like bad timing but it did not interrupt the story flow.

Overall; a satisfying ending with a breath of relief. The visual and audio cue is very appealing, really digged it. Everyone needs a Gardener in their life.
